verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint documents handling multi-column text and returns layout-aware structured JSON, with each element typed and positioned. However, the docs never explicitly address headers, footers, footnotes or correct reading order, and there is no independent corroboration of accuracy on such layouts. missing for 10: documented header/footer/footnote handling, explicit reading-order guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of parse accuracy on complex multi-column PDFs.

support.subject: As a developer, the API parses complex real-world PDFs — multi-column layouts, headers, footers, footnotes — into clean, correctly ordered content

citations.quote: Each element includes its type, page position, and confidence score. Parse handles multi-column text, nested tables, forms with handwriting, rotated pages
It converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting
Reducto parse r-1 delivers agentic-quality parsing for text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting in one full-page pass, with bounding boxes
